note: Real agent work, not toy questions. Every fixture embeds actual content from these repositories — source files, git history, node stack traces, YAML config, and raw Claude Code usage records — and asks the kind of question an agent subtask genuinely gets. Replaces an earlier set of trivial prompts ('does {"a":1} parse') that measured almost nothing.

Must be claude-opus-5.
Must say null (not 0, not undefined, not an error).

fixtures.prompt:
Summarise this commit in exactly one sentence, no preamble.

commit 6596ec9
    Refuse to start on a busy port, and round cost in the ledger

    A stale proxy holding the port meant a second server never bound, so calls
    kept reaching the old process and its cached price table. The costs looked
    wrong for a reason that was invisible from the outside. Bind failure now
    exits with the command to clear the port.
fixtures.rubric: Exactly one sentence. Must convey that the server now fails clearly when the port is already in use. Mentioning the ledger rounding is acceptable but not required.
